title: Asset
description: A fungible unit of value an account's balance and a ledger movement are denominated in (economic identity). DISTINCT FROM Token (one contract instance of this asset on one chain) and from Coin (which is NOT an entity: it is provider nomenclature for a market-data row - see docs/architecture/canonical-model.md D1). NO OWNER AND NO PRODUCER TODAY: no Asset type exists in any language (grep `^type (Asset|Coin|Token)\b` over apps/api returns nothing); the noun is a bare string in six packages (ledger.Entry.Asset, transactions.Transaction.Asset, portfolio.Holding.Asset, portfolio.Exposure.Asset, treasury.Account.Asset, instruments.Instrument.BaseAsset/QuoteAsset). Because no id producer exists, `asset_id` here is the shape a mapping table must eventually fill.

symbol.description: Uppercased display symbol ('BTC'). A display attribute ONLY - symbols are NOT identity, and the contract fixes the common failure of keying money rows on this value.

kind.description: native = a chain's own coin; fiat = an off-chain currency (USD is the unit of every *_usd field); stablecoin is a classification the repo does not currently model, included because the data exists as provider categories.

chain_id.description: Null for off-chain assets (USD) and for an asset that spans chains (its Tokens carry the chain).

decimals.description: On-chain base-10 exponent when known; null when the provider does not report it (never guessed).

provider_ids.description: Provider mappings. EMPTY TODAY - no mapping table or column exists anywhere in database/ (see canonical-model.md D-CANON). Present so a consumer can express 'this is Bitcoin at CryptoRank' without inventing a field.
